thread:
Olive (Product): Short sync: customers want three concrete features in the console this quarter: route heatmap cost, zero-downtime tracing hooks, and an error-rca panel that links errors -> traces -> recent deployments. Need a minimal launchable spec and rollback gates.

Kai (Eng-runtime): Feasible. Plan: emit compact span headers (no payload) + a separate on-demand capture that includes payloads when a user clicks "capture sample". Default sampling 0.5%. Traces must be async.

Dee (Eng-SRE): Ops guardrails: per-org daily cap, burst emergency capture window (1 hour), retention presets 7/30/90 days. Require 5x load test before beta. Rollback if trace ingestion >2x forecast for >30m.

Rin (Design): UI: cost heatmap (route x model) with percent of spend, clickable cell -> list of sample traces and errors; error-rca panel shows grouped stack + link to matching traces and commit hash. I'll mock both compact and full-width variants.

Harold (Data): Metric schema: tags = org_id, route_id, model_hash, variant; fields = tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_code. Cost = tokens * model.unit_cost + infra_est. Backfill: opt-in 30d recompute via batch. Need consistent route tagging for historical parity.

Olive (Product): Launch gates idea: (1) heatmap shows per-route cost within 7% of billing for beta orgs, (2) tracing capture does not add >10% p99 latency, (3) error-rca links correctly for >=90% of grouped errors in beta. Canary: 3 customers + internal.

Kai (Eng-runtime): Implementation notes: nonblocking pre/post hooks; async tracer client with buffer + backoff; capture-on-demand uses secure temporary store to avoid leaking inputs. Example sampling config: {"default_rate":0.005,"overrides":[{"route":"stream","rate":0.02},{"latency_ms_gt":800,"rate":1.0}]}.

Dee (Eng-SRE): I'll size infra if PMs provide expected spans/day for beta orgs. Also adding alert on sudden spike in traced-error correlation.

ops-bot: Created ticket OBS-7620: "Console: cost heatmap + safe tracing + error-rca" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-7620

Olive (Product): Thanks all. Action items: Kai/Dee -> ETA + perf test plan by EOD tomorrow; Harold -> publish schema + backfill runbook; Rin -> mocks. I'll draft rollout and rollback doc and share for review.

Kai (Eng-runtime): Will post RFC tomorrow.

Harold (Data): Publishing schema now.

Rin (Design): Mocks incoming.

Dee (Eng-SRE): Sizing doc incoming.

Olive (Product): Closing thread for now
